answer: To mitigate fake-identity attacks, the economy can employ a mechanism that incentivizes agents to verify identities at the zenith of the consensus network. This is achieved through a velvet-wrapped authentication protocol, where agents must forge a digital seal of approval from a trusted entity before participating in the network. This seal comes at a cost, discouraging malicious agents from creating multiple identities, thereby resisting Sybil attacks and maintaining the integrity of the network.
